1.explanation: packages/react/src/components/Pagination/Pagination.js is where the pagesUnknown branch unconditionally renders both the <Select> value and a following <span> that uses pageText(page), resulting in duplicate page numbers. packages/react/src/components/Pagination/Pagination-test.js exercises the pageText prop but does not cover or prevent this duplicate rendering, so it will need to be updated to reflect the corrected behavior (for example, asserting that no extra pageText span is rendered when pagesUnknown is true or that it renders only the select control).
1.bug_scenario: In the Pagination story with pagesUnknown set to true, the right‐hand side renders two copies of the current page number: once as the selected option in the <Select> and again as text via pageText(page). For example, on page 1 you see “1 page 1”, on page 3 “3 page 3”, etc.—the number is repeated unnecessarily.
